items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: those Chong brothers, you might have heard of them Ralph Chong

ctx.x: They didn't have any fights or anything?

Yeah. During that time, those Chong brothers, you might have heard of them Ralph Chong and a whole bunch of them out there. They used to go to clubs picking fights and all those people out there. But things was reasonable. Of course the money wasn't good. Wasn't making no money out there. I tell these young musicians, man, we wait for 75 cents a night. They don't believe me. 75 cents.
